title: Global Music Genres
subtitle: A Unified Geometric, Thermodynamic & Topological Framework

blocks.text: This chapter presents the poster “Global Music Genres” in full. It is a single dense diagram; open it, then use the explanation, read-aloud, and Ask-AI tools beneath it to work through the ideas at your own pace.

blocks.caption: Figure 14.1 — Global Music Genres.
blocks.explanation: Music across the world is modelled as patterns evolving in high-dimensional spaces: a music manifold that is the product of pitch, rhythm, timbre, dynamics, and cultural-topology spaces. The poster runs global traditions — Western art music, jazz, blues, rock, Latin, sub-Saharan African, Arabic, Persian, Turkish, East Asian, Indonesian gamelan — through the same multi-dimensional lens, comparing scale systems, rhythmic complexity, and a harmonic/modal continuum. Ragas, makams, and modes are coordinate systems on pitch manifolds; rhythms are cycles in time manifolds; music reduces internal entropy by aligning ordered patterns with the listener's generative model. Different traditions, one mathematics of music.
blocks.tts: Global music genres under one lens: a music manifold of pitch, rhythm, timbre, dynamics, and culture, with every tradition a trajectory through the same space.
